text:
mike: Friendly PSA — sticking around for the after-conference music festival. Anyone left luggage in the city safely? :guitar:
hana: Most big train stations have coin lockers or staffed left-luggage rooms. sizes vary so check dimensions online before you arrive.
li: I used Stasher/Bounce in several cities. Book ahead on event weekends 1 helps avoid lines. fees ~€6-12/day typically.
owen: Hotels sometimes hold bags for a small fee or tip. Always ask reception — easier than schlepping. Also bring a daypack + foldable tote for merch.
mike: Want to bring back fragile ceramics. Any packing hacks that arent bubble wrap?
hana: Soft clothes + sweater around items is surprisingly effective. Ask stall owners to double-box when possible. Shipping at the post office is slower but reduces carry risk.
li: If you carry-on: layer fragile in the suitcase center, surround with socks/shirts. hard-shell case helps.
owen: Festival shuttles may limit luggage space. Check the organizer FAQ (some forbid suitcases on shuttle buses).
travel-bot: Reminder: personal weekend activities are not company-covered. If you extend travel nights, split business vs personal in the travel portal so expenses map correctly to policy.
mike: Quick language tip for markets? Any polite bargaining phrases to try? :earth_africa:
hana: Smile first, ask price, then counter politely (e.g., say youll return later). Trying a short local phrase for 'how much' goes a long way. Vendors appreciate the effort.
mike: Perfect  thanks yall. Ill drop a short note in the offsite thread with locker locations and shuttle rules for anyone joining the festival.
